attempts.prompt: Create a production-ready pixel-art sprite sheet for a fantasy game spell named ManaShield. Exactly eight sequential frames, strict uniform 4 columns by 2 rows, all cells equal with no gaps; top row left to right then bottom row left to right. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Each cell contains only the visual effect: a SMOOTH ROUND SPHERICAL translucent pale-blue mana bubble shielding an invisible character. NO characters, no objects inside. This is a magical soap-bubble-like glowing globe of liquid blue mana, NOT a hexagonal technological dome: absolutely no hexagons, honeycomb grid, polygons, panels, circuit patterns, hard facets, electricity bolts, lettering, numbers, UI, checkerboard background or black background. Clear circular silhouette, gently curved cyan rim, one delicate highlight arc, soft blue swirls flowing along outer rim, tiny drifting mana motes, near-transparent empty central 60% so the target behind is very clearly visible. The whole sphere is visible, including its rounded lower edge; delicate ellipse of pooled mana at the bottom/contact baseline may be subtle, without heavy solid ground ring. The SAME sphere center, baseline, scale and radius remain fixed for all frames. Frame1: a thin elliptical mana halo and faint round sphere outline appears. Frame2: rising translucent arcs fill the lower quarter of the fixed circle. Frame3: arcs rise around the sides to form 70% of the globe. Frame4: complete thin blue round sphere gently forms. Frame5: complete sphere briefly glows with fluid swirling rim and brightest delicate highlights; central interior stays transparent. Frame6: same complete sphere softens into faint mana wisps. Frame7: sphere dissolves into sparse transparent outer blue motes. Frame8: a few fading blue particles, nothing opaque remains. The art must fit COMPLETELY inside every individual cell with at least 7% fully transparent padding on every side; no effects overflow a cell. Whole sphere occupies at most 82% cell width and 82% cell height. Pixel-art with crisp intentional clusters and modest soft alpha glow, cyan azure cool blue palette, elegant calm low brightness. No opaque blue disc; all inside bubbles alpha <=0.12 except the thin outer rim. No clipping, no perspective distortion: the complete bubble is round viewed from the front. Uniform orthographic side-view game VFX, stable alignment across rows. Output only the eight-frame sprite sheet.

Produce a refined fantasy-game pixel-art VFX sprite sheet: 8 frames, STRICT 4x2 uniform equal cells. True transparent RGBA, effects only. ManaShield is a CLEAR GLASSY SPHERICAL bubble of BLUE MANA. Visually a round transparent soap bubble with a VERY THIN delicate cyan outline and small pale-blue highlight arc, almost invisible clear inside. No filled blue shape, no opaque annulus, no thick ring, no donut, no cavity opening, no inner black hole edge. This is one EMPTY TRANSPARENT ROUND GLOBE; the only strongly visible parts are its extremely thin outer circular rim (only 2% radius thick), a small white-blue highlight along its upper-left exterior, and a few delicate blue wisps curving along the edge. The central 85% diameter of each bubble is clear transparency, with no interior pixels obscuring a game character. Absolutely NO hexagons, honeycomb, grid, panels, polygons, crystalline facets, machines, characters, text, numbers, electric bolts or background. Orthographic front view, perfectly circular outer silhouette, upper and lower edge equally round, no flattened dome base. Every bubble stays in the SAME exact center with SAME diameter and shape through all eight cells, across rows. Whole globe diameter at most 68% of each cell; all other marks stay within that circle. Generous transparent empty margins on every side including bottom. No stray particles in margins or at cell edges. Frame0: thin circular outline barely beginning at low alpha. Frame1: half of that same fixed-size circle traced by gentle mana wisps. Frame2: circle 80% traced. Frame3: complete thin transparent blue spherical bubble. Frame4: complete bubble with a small graceful pale highlight, NEVER thicker rim or filled interior. Frame5: same globe becomes fainter. Frame6: thin outline breaks into sparse tiny blue flecks close to the circle. Frame7: only 3-5 faint motes remain along the same circle. Crisp elegant pixel clusters, calm blue/cyan palette with light semitransparent subtle glow. Very spare restrained rendering. An energy SHIELD through which the target is wholly visible, not a portal or solid sphere. Output only sprite sheet with actual transparency, not a black or checkerboard backdrop.

An eight-frame pixel art animation sprite sheet for a fantasy magical MANA SHIELD, on actual transparent background. Equal 4 columns and 2 rows. Every frame is a complete round 3D spherical protective soap bubble made of very translucent blue mana, side view. Smooth unbroken spherical shell, continuous glass-like translucent faint blue surface across the entire face, pale blue crescent specular reflection on its upper-left and small highlight on its lower-right to suggest 3D roundness. It looks like a soap bubble surrounding a unit that will be composited later. The circular face is lightly tinted translucent pale blue, never a cut-out central hole, never a torus, never a portal. No hexagonal patterns, no facets, no grids, no panels. No character is drawn inside, effects only. Restraint: few small wisps of mana and very faint shimmering curved reflections, with no thick cloudy rim. The bubble fits in a circle centered in each cell, diameter exactly 65% of the cell, leaving large empty transparent padding everywhere. Same center and size across all eight cells. The sequence is: a faint spherical shell appears, it becomes a little more visible, mana softly flows over the spherical surface, full translucent glass sphere, a subtle pulse across the sphere, its visibility recedes, sphere fades to a thin translucent reflection, only a few fading motes remain. The interior must be low-opacity translucent light-blue GLASS, not black and not an empty dark hole. Gentle clean crisp pixel art suitable for a small mobile RPG, elegant pale cyan and blue, subtle soft alpha glow. Keep each whole bubble and every wisp wholly inside its cell. No text, no character, no objects, no opaque backdrop, no flat bottom dome. A round complete lightly blue translucent protective globe.

Edit this eight-frame mana shield sprite sheet. KEEP the 4 by 2 sheet and blue pixel-art style, but replace every portal/torus with a complete GLASS SPHERE. Fill the central circular hole in every frame with a smooth continuous light-blue spherical surface. No hole, no empty opening, no inner contour line. It must visibly be a soap-bubble ball, not a ring. Use soft blue shading over the entire circular face, a rounded blue silhouette, brighter highlight crescent on upper-left, dimmer reflection lower-right. The circular face is continuous smooth pale blue throughout its center. The game will display the whole sprite at low alpha, so draw a continuous globe face clearly. The sphere is a round whole ball, not a flat-bottom dome and not a polygon or hexagon. Keep the image background fully transparent. No character. Ensure each entire sphere has ample transparent margin in its own cell and no edge effects or stray motes overlap adjacent frames. Make diameter 65% cell width and height, same center and shape in all cells. Animation sequence: tiny faint blue spherical outline, faint sphere filling in, complete softly glowing glass sphere, completed sphere, softly pulsing sphere, sphere faintly fades, very faint sphere fading out, small 3 blue motes. The peak fourth and fifth frames must have a FULL CONTINUOUS BLUE GLASS BALL including the center, without a central hole. This transparent blue magical ball can protect a unit that is separately composited in game.
